newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wong's gets nod for Singapore spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Wong's gets nod for Singapore spin-off.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Wong's International (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday the Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd had approved in principle the listing of its wholly-owned Wong's Circuit (Holdings) Ltd on the main board of the Singapore stock exchange.
Wong's Circuit will hold the company's printed circuit board interests and related businesses.
The company said it "will determine the terms of the share offer shortly, including the exact number of shares...to be offered, the time of making the offer, the offer price etc."

In June, Wong's International had said 7.6 percent of the proposed offering of Wong's Circuit would be offered to the public in Singapore, 17.8 percent would be placed to institutional investors, and the company would hold the remaining 74.6 percent.
